messages:
sam: Hey finance — corpcard charge for a ‘last-mile’ bike shuttle (SpinShuttleNY) showed up on my statement for $18.50 on 2024-06-15 but I don't have an itemized receipt. Only bank memo. Do I need anything else to reconcile?

linda: Hi Sam — bank memos sometimes pass for ground transport but we prefer an itemized merchant receipt. If none, we need a manager approval + a short explanation in the expense note. Is this client-related travel or internal?

sam: Not client-related, personal travel between SFO terminal and hotel after a late flight. I have a photo of the paper receipt (their terminal kiosk printed it) — uploading: https://files.redwood.com/receipts/IMG_20240615_0932.jpg

trevor: FYI this vendor often only prints short slips. Per travel policy 3.2 we accept bank memo + manager confirmation when itemized receipt unavailable. You should note route and reason (last-mile ground transport).

maya: Confirmed — approving reimbursement. Maya Lee (manager) approves this as a business trip ground transport expense. Sam please add "manager approval: Maya Lee" to the Ramp submission notes.

finance-bot: Auto-ticket created: EXP-20240615-789. Status: pending documentation. Manager approval attached. Missing-receipt flag: cleared.

linda: Thanks — Sam, once you add the note and attach the receipt image to the Ramp expense, we'll queue it for next payroll cycle. For the record, code it to GL: 6102 (Ground Transport).

sam: Done — added note and attached image in Ramp. Thanks all :thumbsup:

linda: Closing on our side once processed. If the card network later disputes the merchant descriptor, we'll reach out.
